about: The held-out lane's fixture (scripts/heldout.mjs --manifest=bench/heldout/fixture/manifest.json): programs in the sets' shapes, written for the tests, that drive the fetch, the drivers, the record and the gate where no set may be read. Not a held-out set.

sets.name: the fixture in Are We Fast Yet's shape
sets.about: Two programs written for the tests to the documented interface: squares verifies in every engine, evaluated builds code at run time (Function), which jz does not compile.

sets.name: the fixture in the Benchmarks Game's shape
sets.about: Six programs written for the tests: harmonic prints with console.log, bitmap writes a PBM image's bytes with process.stdout.write, roots prints a sum that is wrong under jz ((-Infinity) ** 0.5 is NaN there, Infinity in JavaScript), cores requires Node's os module, sloppy assigns names it never declares and forks spreads its work over processes, the last two marked notMeasured as a program of a set the lane cannot run is; each <n>_out is the program's output under node, run as a script, at n.

programs.notMeasured: a script of sloppy mode: it assigns n and show, names it never declares, which a script makes globals of and the driver, an ES module and so strict, refuses with a ReferenceError
it forks a worker of the running script (cluster) and prints what the worker sends back, where a lane runs one program in one process
